title.label: Dictation is amazing but the keyboard is awful

content.label: The dictation on this is truly so much better than what is built into iOS. I love it. The problem is the keyboard that it is integrated into is awful. It is so much worse than Apple’s keyboard that I have to switch back to Apple’s keyboard for regular typing. and then back again to Wispr Flow every time I want to use dictation. So I only end up using Wispr Flow for longer dictation. I hope they put some work into the keyboard so that it can be only keyboard I use on iOS.
